title: IDF Strikes Kill Two Hamas Militants in Deir al-Balah, One Identified as Oct. 7 Nukhba Fighter
detail: The Israeli military said it struck and killed two Hamas militants in Deir al-Balah overnight into Monday, August 24, 2026. One was identified as a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba force who took part in the October 7, 2023 assault on Israeli territory. The IDF said the pair had been planning to 'advance terror attacks' against Israeli troops operating in the Gaza Strip and had been working to rebuild Hamas capabilities, in violation of the ceasefire agreed in October 2025.

media.caption: IDF says it struck two Hamas militants in Deir al-Balah, Aug 24, 2026

title: Israeli Strikes Hit Water Desalination Plant, Two Mosques as IDF Says It Targeted Hamas Weapons Storage
detail: Israeli strikes on Monday, August 24, 2026 hit a water desalination plant and a mosque in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood, cutting potable water access for thousands of displaced families in the area, and destroyed the historic Abu Salim Mosque in Deir al-Balah — one of Gaza's oldest religious landmarks. The IDF and Shin Bet said they struck two Hamas weapons-storage facilities located inside mosques in the Shati and Deir al-Balah areas. The strikes were part of a wider wave across Gaza that killed at least 7 Palestinians and wounded several others, including two children — 4-year-old Hassan al-Hafi in the Bureij refugee camp and Amal Nash'at Abu Khater.

media.caption: Historic Abu Salim Mosque in Deir al-Balah destroyed by Israeli strike, Aug 24, 2026

title: 4-Year-Old Hassan al-Hafi Killed in Israeli Strike on Al-Bureij Refugee Camp
detail: An Israeli strike on the Al-Bureij refugee camp in central Gaza on August 24, 2026 killed 4-year-old Hassan al-Hafi, one of two children among at least 7 Palestinians killed across Gaza that day in strikes that also hit Khan Younis and Deir al-Balah. Al Jazeera's Tareq Abu Azzoum, reporting from Deir al-Balah, said 'people on the ground say the ceasefire has effectively represented an extension of the war itself, as attacks continue without respite.' The Palestinian death toll since the October 2025 ceasefire reached 1,288, with 73,422 killed and 174,401 wounded since October 2023.

media.caption: Israeli strikes across Gaza kill at least 7, including two children, Aug 24, 2026
